gen-gf-tektur-gf-golos-text: Tall, plain-spoken lowercase fills the line, with a widely parted s and strokes of a single width. Golos Text would carry a long page without tiring, leaving Tektur's quirky display shapes to do the shouting.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Small letters that stand nearly as tall as capitals, with a clear gap where the c ends, make Hedvig Letters Sans easy to settle into. Give it a little extra size and Tektur's rod-like headings still lead.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-heebo: Distinctive is the right word for Tektur, whose letters look built from rods rather than carved blades. Heebo sits underneath with a tall central band and curves that stop short, and that quiet difference is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur looks like stamped metal type, tall in the lowercase and drawn with no thick-thin shift. Hind Guntur lets Tektur's open-ended, pipe-cleaner curves stand out above it while its own wide gaps keep the text moving.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, its s curves opening wide at both ends. And if Tektur were shrunk down, its oversized lowercase would lose the swagger that makes it stand apart.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary is how the text face feels, with lowercase pressing close to the ascender height and every a left ajar. Hind Mysuru stays quietly unfussy under Tektur, whose expressive, oddly proportioned letters get the stage to themselves.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and a gentle step up from small letters to capitals. Hind Siliguri settles into a flat gray hum over many lines, a steady floor beneath Tektur's showier display forms.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-vadodara: Professional through and through, the body keeps its thickness constant in every direction. Hind Vadodara's spacious gaps and big open-looking e and a make a tidy foil for Tektur's expressive, outsized lowercase up top.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-huninn:
Tektur brings expressive letters with generously opened curves.

Huninn follows with lowercase rising close to cap height and crossbars as fat as their stems, so a long passage reads with a steady, sturdy texture.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight reads like bent tubing, with short ascenders and curve tails held back. Over a long passage it stays crisp and tidy, which lets Tektur's distinctive display shapes carry the personality.
